<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .

# Shape that validates a QUDT QuantityValue (used via sh:node, not a target class)
_:QuantityValueShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:hasValue unit:M ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
    ] .

# Shape for Ice Class Design Parameter Set – the only admitted target class
nltl:IceClassDesignParameterSetShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:iceClassDesignParameterSet ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:levelIceThickness ;
        sh:node _:QuantityValueShape ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Level ice thickness (hi) for the ice class." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:designIceLoadHeight ;
        sh:node _:QuantityValueShape ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:description "Design ice load height (h) for the ice class." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
